Cheerful handover clear rules for gate calls
This page helps new colleagues see what is expected
Companion Animal Travel Desk arrival pickup matters because calm, accurate handoff protects pets, travelers, and the airport flow at Aurelia Skyways. When a flight comes in, keep your language simple and your checks steady. Listen for the details in the record, confirm the care plan, and stay alert for any sign of stress, heat, or travel fatigue. <<FACT F101>> If a traveler arrives worried, answer with confidence and stick to the steps already agreed with the passenger coordinator. A pet may need a quiet pace, a secure carrier check, or a brief pause before moving on. Watch for signs of a loose latch, a confused owner, or a pet that looks overwhelmed, and bring in the safety coordinator when something seems off. Keep handovers polite, direct, and private so the traveler knows the process is under control. Good notes help the next colleague continue without gaps, and they also support safer service for every animal in our care. Remember to stay calm, follow the record, and protect both comfort and safety.
